boundary_behavior: Periodic wrap in the canonical run; reflect is evaluated separately.
computational_assumptions: Local fits within a fixed stage are independent.
Exact Fourier energy calculations require a regular periodic grid.
estimator: Quadratic-loss normalized kernel-weighted local mean; component operator W_k A_(k−1), with A_(k−1)=∏_(j<k)(I−W_j).
kernel: Project-labelled Epanechnikov weights K(u)=0.75(1−|u|)^2_+, normalized discretely.
name: Linear recursive IMF
objective: Extract a sequence of locally smoothed components from the current residual and subtract each component before reducing the window.
solver: Direct weighted mean at every time point.

boundary_behavior: Periodic wrap in the canonical experiment.
computational_assumptions: Stages are sequential because each fit depends on the current residual.
Local scalar fits within a stage may be parallelized.
No fixed global linear matrix represents the robust recursion.
estimator: At each t and stage k, minimize the normalized kernel-weighted sum of smooth absolute-value contrasts ρ_H(r_k(u)−x).
kernel: Project-labelled Epanechnikov weights K(u)=0.75(1−|u|)^2_+, normalized discretely.
name: Robust gradient-descent recursive IMF/IRMF
objective: Replace the local mean with a bounded-score robust location fit while retaining sequential residual subtraction.
robust_loss: ρ_H(r)=r erf(r/(sqrt(2)H))+sqrt(2/pi) H exp(−r²/(2H²)); score ψ_H(r)=erf(r/(sqrt(2)H)), bounded in [−1,1].
solver: Vectorized local gradient descent initialized at the local median, clipped to the local data range, with a lookup grid over r/H in [−8,8].

computational_assumptions: The window half-widths shrink approximately geometrically.
The scaling retains stage-specific operator-energy or sandwich constants.
It is not a sup-error calibration.
estimator: Divide each stage-k error by a^(k/2), with a=sqrt(2); a^((k−1)/2) differs only by a common factor.
name: Geometric bandwidth error scaling
objective: Check whether stagewise component error follows the nominal inverse-square-root bandwidth rate.
robust_loss: Applicable as a descriptive normalization to either linear or robust outputs.

boundary_behavior: Exact circulant calculation for wrap; finite-domain operators are needed for other boundaries.
computational_assumptions: Regular periodic design gives equal row norms at every t.
estimator: Divide e_k by σ times the l2 norm of the impulse response of W_k A_(k−1).
kernel: Inherited exact discrete project kernel and rounded window schedule.
name: Exact linear operator-energy scaling
objective: Calibrate each linear recursive component by the standard deviation transmitted by its complete finite-dimensional stage operator.
robust_loss: Not applicable; exact only for the fixed linear operator.
solver: FFT or impulse-response calculation followed by deterministic normalization.

boundary_behavior: Inherits the simulated experiment's wrap boundary.
computational_assumptions: The parametric data-generating model is adequate.
The result is model- and target-dependent.
An RMS denominator does not calibrate sup error.
estimator: Root mean square of e_k^(b)(t) across bootstrap replicates and time points under a fully specified signal, noise, contamination, loss, window schedule, and clean-fit reference.
name: Parametric-bootstrap robust stage scaling
objective: Estimate a stage-specific RMS denominator for nonlinear recursive robust component errors.
solver: Repeat the complete robust recursion under simulated observations and standardize by the bootstrap RMS.

boundary_behavior: Uses the configured window boundary; the canonical diagnostic uses periodic wrap.
computational_assumptions: The smoother is a fixed linear operator.
No earlier residual operator A_(k−1) is applied.
White homoscedastic noise is an additional assumption when converting row energy to variance.
estimator: The normalized kernel-weighted mean W_k; its linear single-pass perturbation is d_k=W_k epsilon rather than W_k A_(k−1) epsilon.
kernel: Project-labelled Epanechnikov weights K(u)=0.75(1−|u|)^2_+, normalized discretely.
name: Linear single-pass local smoother
objective: Apply the stage-k linear local smoother directly to the original observation or noise without preceding recursive residual subtractions.
solver: Direct normalized weighted mean at the chosen bandwidth.
